name: ipsecReplayProtectionEnabled
definition: Every configured IPSec tunnel has anti-replay set to yes.
population: IPSec tunnels configured on the one firewall the credential reaches
evidenceRequiredForTrue: The IPSec tunnel configuration listing at least one tunnel with every tunnel showing anti-replay yes.
citations: PAN-OS 11.1 XML API and configure CLI command hierarchy (docs.paloaltonetworks.com/pan-os/11-1/pan-os-panorama-api)

changeLog.change: Registered with its first implementation (synthetic-fixture tests only; no real device body replayed yet, so V0).

notes: network/tunnel/ipsec/entry/anti-replay (yes or no) from the CLI hierarchy. A tunnel that does not show the element is unknown, not off, because the default is not evidenced.
